title: Forensic
summary: FOREN'SIC, adjective [from Latin forensis, from forum, a court.] Belonging to courts of judicature; used in courts or legal proceedings; as a forensic term; forensic eloquence or disputes.

inlines.v: FOREN'SIC, adjective [from Latin forensis, from forum, a court.] Belonging to courts of judicature; used in courts or legal proceedings; as a forensic term; forensic eloquence or disputes.
